facts.label: 来源冲突与采用依据
value: Touch IRQ travels through TCA9554 EX0 to MCU GPIO1; it is not a direct GPIO1 FT interrupt. Touch reset is pulled high by R24; R22 to RTC EX1 is NC and must not reset touch.
No AXP2101 is fitted. EX2 LCD_EN/DSI is not treated as an invented power switch. Factory source leaves EX2 input while configuring battery/amp EX6/7.
Published FT6146 identity uses common FT5x06 report byte layout. This subset returns sourced contacts and rejects unknown private version/ID selectors; it does not assert an FT3168 die identity.

Exact official BIN and11_FactoryProgram demonstrate a comprehensive example. A distinct default-shipping/recovery purpose is not explicitly documented in retained prose, so it is labelled official example trial, not accepted factory recovery.

Native689 source components are retained in34 draw groups. Emissive36.35 mm, cover viewing36.75 mm, cover46 mm and case48 mm are distinct; no rescaling. Case-B archive is only2D PDF/DWG, so case shell is explicit unverified reconstruction.
Original full image stops at4.594s in BLE encryption assertion; green test image/performance overlay is not application acceptance.

limitations: Native source preserves every689 topology;24 original/fallback colors are grouped for rendering, not omitted or geometrically merged.
Native emissive36.35 mm differs from36.75 mm cover viewing aperture. The latter is not relabelled active area.
Native total height11.8003 mm includes headers; current photograph9.60 mm differs. Source is not rescaled; revision/measurement scope remains unresolved.
Bare native switch282 maps to BOOT and283 to PWR from the unchanged rear photo and USB/connector frame. Case actuators have no retained3D geometry and remain workbench-only controls.
No physical assembly fit, calibrated optical appearance, touch registration or browser WebGL acceptance claim.

collectionNotes: 部分适配：真实ESP32-C6容量、精确总线、数字显示/复位及已列输入；完整应用、浏览器与实物尚未验收。
厂家完整镜像保持原字节、分区和校验通过；逐型号运行结果保留，不以CLI退出码代替成功。
音频PCM、无线业务、模拟电源/充电/电池ADC、物理屏幕扫描/颜色及触摸配准仍未验收。
3D保留厂家CAD或尺寸依据；UNKNOWN内部与推测厚度/排针不能用作装配尺寸。
TF数字卡接口按此硬件版本接入；本次原厂快照未插卡，不将无卡错误解释为无卡槽。
原厂最终快照 18 种RGB颜色。 详见native-stop-summaries及逐版本限制。
Original full image stops via software reset at4.594 emulated seconds after BLE hardware-encryption assertion;1 exception.
39 RAMWR/672936 pixels;18 RGB colors;green field plus performance overlay, not home-screen acceptance.
Sensor self-test lacks dynamic completion and no SD card was attached; those error logs do not mean no physical IMU/socket.
Touch IRQ travels through TCA9554 EX0 to MCU GPIO1; it is not a direct GPIO1 FT interrupt. Touch reset is pulled high by R24; R22 to RTC EX1 is NC and must not reset touch.
No AXP2101 is fitted. EX2 LCD_EN/DSI is not treated as an invented power switch. Factory source leaves EX2 input while configuring battery/amp EX6/7.
Published FT6146 identity uses common FT5x06 report byte layout. This subset returns sourced contacts and rejects unknown private version/ID selectors; it does not assert an FT3168 die identity.

Exact official BIN and11_FactoryProgram demonstrate a comprehensive example. A distinct default-shipping/recovery purpose is not explicitly documented in retained prose, so it is labelled official example trial, not accepted factory recovery.

Native689 source components are retained in34 draw groups. Emissive36.35 mm, cover viewing36.75 mm, cover46 mm and case48 mm are distinct; no rescaling. Case-B archive is only2D PDF/DWG, so case shell is explicit unverified reconstruction.
Original full image stops at4.594s in BLE encryption assertion; green test image/performance overlay is not application acceptance.

limitations: All runtime statuses remain partial; original complete-image outcomes and source conflicts are preserved. LCD169 zip-bundle requires root256MiB hash-pinned container limit.
